name: agent-model-comparison
description: Fan the same deep-research question out to every enabled agent CLI. Each pool picks its own model. A `verify` step ranks the answers and a `summarize` step writes the final report. Demonstrates multi-pool meter-paced routing + the new `verify` (skeptic) step.

question.default: What changed in the Bullswarm v0.5.0 release compared to v0.4.0? List the 10 gap closures, explain why each one mattered, and identify any gap that is still open.
